history.note: harness until the mode-cutoff restart (borg-zoo#54). The runner and observer are unchanged at the new pin; the bump keeps the harness commit at the specimens' tree after the 0100/0101/0101a fixes. A proposed runner change that would have recorded the applied configuration text (better-borg-c PR 435) was closed as mis-filed and is not needed: configuration_sha256 already identifies what a run applied.
live watchdog read could abort a run on a split UTF-8 character (better-borg-c#220); fixed by 56ccf741. The observer is unchanged between the two pins.

harness.note: The better-borg-c runner and observer at this commit build and run every specimen. A specimen is the game and Borg source at its own ref; the observer instrumentation comes from the harness commit. It applies to specimens of kind "better-borg-c" (the default). Specimens of kind "borg-rs" are built and run by borg-rs's own harness at the specimen's ref (harness/build.sh and the borgh frontend). This pin is also a specimen ref (4.2.6-bbc-9ca98661): the harness bumped with the mode-cutoff restart so runner and specimens move together (borg-zoo#54).

4.2.6-reborn-rust-main-fdaf18e5.label: borg-reborn-rs fdaf18e5, main at the merge of #480 (the speed30 bundle made the shipped default), with #473 (never use unidentified items; discard Deep Descent). Source-hash rust 258ccc77107e...; harness/borg.txt 1b062d8b... sets borg_reborn_core = borg-rs, borg_town_plan = 1, the trip policy (unknown_stacks 5, pack_slack 1), heal when outmatched, attack_speed_fight_danger_tenths = 30 and the 16 attack preferences; no plan, errand none.

experiment.name: reborn-main-defaults-pilot
experiment.owner_authorization: 2026-11-17: the owner asked for a pilot of current borg-reborn-rs main with its shipped default settings (borg-zoo#181). Small only after the pilot gate and the owner (RULES 14).
experiment.prespecified:
Fixed 2026-11-17, before any result was read (borg-zoo#181). Pilot only (RULES 14); small (or verysmall)
only after this gate and the owner. Gate: no config_error; one binary, its play hashes recorded; the
written borg.txt carries the shipped settings (borg_reborn_core = borg-rs, the trip policy, the 18
borg_param_* lines) and no borg_plan; every cell ends in death, turn_cap or borg_stopped; frozen-turn
stalls and key outliers are listed; no "# Quaffing/Reading/Eating unknown" notes and no Deep Descent
read (checked on the death replays). Descriptive only: deaths, final level, deepest level, keys,
trip returns and the count of "no up stairs found, going down" (from a replay). The four death
starts of run 44054277431 are compared start by start with that run's control
(reborn-bundle-none-speed30 on 193d9076); they are different games, so this compares outcomes only.
18 starts cannot show whether main is better.
